name: Statistics and Data Science
about: Statistics is the science and art of prediction and explanation. Its mathematical foundation lies in probability theory, which is applied to inference and decision-making under uncertainty. Data science expands on statistics to encompass the entire life cycle of data, from specification, gathering, and cleaning through management and analysis to its use in decisions and policy. Students majoring in Statistics and Data Science study both mathematical and practical foundations, including computational methods, data visualization, machine learning, and data mining.
